key_impacts: 243,191 houses washed away and 370,587 partially damaged in Bangladesh
In Dakshin Bedkashi union, 33 people were killed
3,520 houses washed away and 1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi
Storm surge overtopped coastal embankments, breaching them in six places and damaging 20.55 km (of 27.37 km)
Villages in Dakshin Bedkashi were inundated twice daily by tidal water until coastal polders were rehabilitated in 2013
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65 knots winds and a 2–6 m storm surge
It washed away 243,191 houses and left 370,587 houses partially damaged
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila and the storm surge killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, partially damaged 1,800; embankment breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged
